Ken Griffin Donates $3 Billion to Carnegie Mellon University

Billionaire Ken Griffin has pledged $3 billion to Carnegie Mellon University, marking the largest donation to higher education in U.S. history. The gift is intended for the university's South Florida campus. This donation is described as 'historic' and a 'record' gift.
